changes.text: Fixed a bug in the Teleportation travel power. The cast time previously allowed you to cast the power a second time before the animation finished. This has been corrected.
Increased total Endurance for Elite Bosses (slight increase to Boss and Lts.)
Temp powers that can be purchased are now buyable even when the enhancement tray is full.
Siren's Call, Warburg: Added police drones to hospital interiors
Slightly modified Carnival of Shadows, Vanessa's powers.
Controller Ancillary power Earth's Embrace now correctly adds more to max hit points when slotted with Heal enhancements.
Dominators "Smoke" power will now correctly auto-hit Heroic critters. It still requires a To Hit check versus players, however.
Assault Bots no longer "smash" their targets.
